doors.when: Running any gh command from a hosted Desk child, which first fetches a fresh installation token so long sessions keep working
doors.confirm: This runs the real gh with a fresh installation token for the desk repository, so a write command acts on GitHub; go ahead?

errors.means: No real gh was found: DESK_REAL_GH is unset and no other gh on PATH is executable (exit 127).
errors.fix: Install gh in the image or set DESK_REAL_GH to its full path.

errors.means: DESK_TOKEN_SOCKET is not set, so the shim has no gateway to ask for a token.
errors.fix: Run it from a Desk child the gateway started, which carries DESK_TOKEN_SOCKET.

errors.means: The token socket could not be reached or did not answer within 30 seconds.
errors.fix: Check that the gateway process is still running, then rerun the gh command.

errors.means: The gateway answered but could not mint an installation token, for example because the GitHub App is not installed.
errors.fix: Read the gateway's reason in the message and fix the App's installation or key.

doors.when: Standing up or reconciling the gateway Container App (prod, or STAGE=staging), with DRY_RUN=1 first to print every change
doors.confirm: Without DRY_RUN=1 this creates or updates Azure resources (image, Container App, secrets, domain, federated credential); go ahead?

errors.means: STAGE, REMOVE_OURO_SETTINGS or DESK_GITHUB_SIGNIN holds a value the script refuses; it stops before reading Azure.
errors.fix: Pass STAGE=prod or staging, REMOVE_OURO_SETTINGS=1, or DESK_GITHUB_SIGNIN=on or off.

errors.means: az could not read the Container App or pull identity for a reason other than not found, such as an expired sign-in.
errors.fix: Run az login for the subscription and rerun.

errors.means: az 2.77's YAML update hit a Key Vault reference without a value (KeyError) and sent nothing of this update.
errors.fix: Record it for the rehearsal; the update path needs a fix before this app can be updated.

errors.means: After the update the new revision failed or was not ready within READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS; the old revision still serves.
errors.fix: Read the new revision's logs with az containerapp logs show, fix the setting and rerun.

doors.when: Creating the ouro-desk-hooks receiver beside the gateway, or rerunning once its hooks.ouro.bot DNS records exist to bind the domain
doors.confirm: Without --dry-run this creates the ouro-desk-hooks Container App with the gateway's client key and binds its custom domain; go ahead?

errors.means: An argument other than --dry-run was given; the script exits 2 before reading Azure.
errors.fix: Pass --dry-run or nothing, and set IMAGE or HOOKS_DOMAIN in the environment.

errors.means: az could not read ouro-desk-hooks for a reason other than not found.
errors.fix: Check the az sign-in to the subscription and rerun.

errors.means: The receiver's latest revision was not ready, or /healthz did not answer 200, within READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
errors.fix: Read az containerapp logs show for ouro-desk-hooks, fix it and rerun.

errors.means: The CNAME or asuid TXT record for the domain is not in DNS yet, so the domain was skipped.
errors.fix: Add the two printed records in ouro.bot's DNS, DNS only, and run it again.

doors.when: Building or reconciling an Ouro tenant for test or prod, or running one action on it: Apple key import, seeding, invites, key rotations
doors.confirm: Without --dry-run this creates or changes Entra apps, roles, Key Vault secrets, Container App settings and GitHub environment variables; go ahead?

errors.means: Entra still refuses the admin app's secret this run just made.
errors.fix: Run it again in a few minutes; the secret stays in the macOS keychain.

doors.when: Daily expiry checks on the tenant's Entra and Apple secrets and the legacy cutoff, or renewing or recording the Apple key slot
doors.confirm: With --renew-apple or --record-apple-upload this PATCHes the tenant's Apple provider or writes Key Vault tags; go ahead?

errors.means: az's current account, or the admin app's token, is not in this env's Ouro tenant; nothing else was checked.
errors.fix: Sign az in to the tenant the identity record names, or pass --admin-app on the operator's machine.

errors.means: The Entra client secret or the Apple client secret ends within 30 days.
errors.fix: Rotate it: provision-identity.mjs --rotate entra-secret, or --renew-apple for Apple.

errors.means: The serving revision maps GitHub accounts but no release is recorded and DESK_LEGACY_CUTOFF is not set.
errors.fix: Record the release and set the legacy cutoff through provision.sh.

errors.means: An Apple key slot doesn't match its recorded Key ID or import fingerprint, so nothing was sent.
errors.fix: Reimport that slot's key with provision-identity.mjs --apple-key-file and --apple-key-slot.
